svg.title: GitHub App installation token formats and which patterns match them
svg.desc: Top: the legacy installation token is ghs_ followed by 36 alphanumeric characters, 40 characters total. The stateless token is ghs_, the app ID, an underscore, and a JWT with a header, payload, and signature separated by two dots, about 520 characters. Bottom table: results of a test on October 7, 2026 with a synthetic token in the new shape. The legacy pattern ghs_[A-Za-z0-9]{36} and the gitleaks v8.30.1 default github-app-token rule match the legacy token but not the stateless one. The TruffleHog v2 GitHub detector regex matches only up to the first dot. GitHub's recommended pattern ghs_[A-Za-z0-9.-_]{36,} matches both in full.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
